info.title: Tellus Ontology Engine — Actions API
info.description: Complete API specification for the Tellus Ontology Engine Action subsystem. Covers action type CRUD, action execution (single, batch, validate), audit logging, and edit history.

tags.name: Action Types
tags.description: CRUD operations for action type definitions

tags.name: Audit Log
tags.description: Query action execution audit logs and statistics

tags.name: Edit History
tags.description: View edit history for individual objects

post.description: Registers a new action type definition in the specified ontology. The action type defines parameters, rules (side effects), and constraints for a reusable action.

400.description: Validation error (invalid fields, parameter constraints, or rule references)

409.description: Action type with this API name already exists

get.description: Returns all action type definitions registered in the specified ontology.
Returns the full definition of a specific action type by its API name.

put.description: Partially updates an existing action type. At least one field must be provided. When parameters or rules are changed, schema migration validation is performed and warnings may be returned.

200.description: Action type updated successfully. May include migrationWarnings array.

migrationWarnings.description: Warnings about backward-incompatible changes detected by schema migration validation

400.description: Validation error or no updatable fields provided

delete.description: Permanently removes an action type definition. This does not affect previously executed actions or their audit log entries.

post.description: Creates a new action type by copying an existing one. The clone receives a new API name and optionally a new display name.

get.description: Performs a static analysis of the action type's rules to determine which object types, properties, and link types would be affected by execution. Also includes historical execution statistics.

post.description: Executes a single action against the ontology. Supports idempotency via the Idempotency-Key header and optimistic concurrency via $expectedVersion in the request body.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key for idempotent execution. If the same key is resubmitted for the same action type, the cached result is returned with X-Idempotency-Cached: true header.

X-Idempotency-Cached.description: Present and set to 'true' when the response was served from the idempotency cache

400.description: Invalid parameters, missing required fields, or concurrency conflict

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for this action type

post.description: Validates action parameters and rules without executing the action. Returns validation result with a preview of what would happen.
Executes multiple instances of the same action type in a single request. Each request in the batch is executed independently. Maximum batch size is 100, with a total affected object limit of 100,000.

200.description: Batch execution completed (individual results may include failures)

400.description: Invalid batch request (missing requests array, exceeds size limit, etc.)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for batch actions

get.summary: Get audit log for an action type
get.description: Returns paginated audit log entries for a specific action type within an ontology. Supports filtering by result, time range, and executor.

400.description: Invalid parameters (missing actionTypeApiName or invalid result filter)

get.description: Returns paginated audit log entries across all action types. Supports filtering by result, time range, executor, and action type.

parameters.name: actionType
parameters.description: Filter by action type API name

get.summary: Get a single audit log entry
get.description: Returns a single audit log entry by its execution ID. The response is a flat object (not wrapped in a data array).

parameters.name: executionId
parameters.description: The UUID of the action execution

get.description: Returns aggregated execution statistics for the specified time period. Includes total counts, success/failure breakdown, timing percentiles, failure type distribution, and top action types by execution count.

parameters.name: actionType
parameters.description: Filter stats to a single action type API name

get.summary: Get edit history for an object
get.description: Returns paginated edit history for a specific object, ordered by most recent first. Each entry includes the operation performed, property values, link edits, and action metadata.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The API name of the object type

parameters.name: primaryKey
parameters.description: The primary key value of the object

parameters.name: $pageSize
parameters.description: Number of entries per page (default 50, max 500)

400.description: Invalid pageSize, invalid timestamp, or malformed pageToken

get.description: Returns the combined OpenAPI 3.0 JSON specification for the entire Tellus API.

ActionApiName.name: actionApiName
ActionApiName.description: The API name of the action type (used in actionTypes routes as :actionApiName param)

ActionTypeApiName.name: actionTypeApiName
ActionTypeApiName.description: The API name of the action type (used in actions and audit routes)

PageSize.name: $pageSize
PageSize.description: Number of items per page (default 50, max 1000)

PageToken.name: $pageToken
PageToken.description: Base64-encoded cursor for pagination. Obtained from nextPageToken in a previous response.

ResultFilter.name: result
ResultFilter.description: Filter audit entries by execution result

StartTime.name: startTime
StartTime.description: Filter entries on or after this ISO 8601 timestamp

EndTime.name: endTime
EndTime.description: Filter entries on or before this ISO 8601 timestamp

apiName.description: Unique parameter identifier within the action type

objectType.description: Required when type is object_reference or object_set. Specifies the target object type.

param.description: Name of the parameter to source the value from. Required when source is 'parameter'.

type.description: The type of side effect this rule describes

objectType.description: Target object type API name. Required for createObject, modifyObject, and deleteObject rules.

properties.description: Map of property API names to their value sources. Valid for createObject and modifyObject rules.

linkTypeApiName.description: Target link type API name. Used for addLink and removeLink rules.

actionTypeId.description: Unique identifier for the action type

apiName.description: Unique API name used in URLs and references

description.description: Optional description of the action type's purpose

parameters.description: Input parameters accepted by the action

rules.description: Side-effect rules executed when the action is applied

maxAffectedObjects.description: Maximum number of objects that can be affected in a single execution

isEnabled.description: Whether the action type is currently enabled for execution

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the action type was created

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the action type was last updated

createdBy.description: Identity of the user who created the action type

apiName.description: Unique API name. Must start with a letter, followed by alphanumeric or underscore characters.

isEnabled.description: Whether the action type is enabled (default true)

UpdateActionTypeRequest.description: At least one field must be provided

newApiName.description: API name for the cloned action type

newDisplayName.description: Optional display name for the clone. Defaults to 'Copy of <source displayName>'.

$expectedVersion.description: Optional expected version for optimistic concurrency control

branchId.description: Optional branch context for the execution

parameters.description: Key-value map of action parameters to validate

requests.description: Array of action requests to execute (max 100)

branchId.description: Default branchId for all requests (can be overridden per-request)

affectedObjects.description: List of objects affected by the action

totalRequests.description: Total number of requests in the batch

totalDurationMs.description: Total batch execution duration in milliseconds

index.description: Zero-based index of the request in the batch

affectedObjects.description: Objects affected by this request (present on success)

actionTypeApiName.description: API name of the action type that was executed

actionTypeDisplayName.description: Display name of the action type

sourceIp.description: IP address of the request source

nextPageToken.description: Base64-encoded cursor for the next page (null if no more pages)

totalExecutions.description: Total number of executions in the period

failureBreakdown.description: Map of failure types to their occurrence counts

topActionTypes.description: Top 10 action types by execution count

actionTypeApiName.description: API name of the analyzed action type

exists.description: Whether the object type exists in the ontology

operations.description: Operations performed on this object type

propertiesModified.description: List of property API names modified by the action

affectedObjectTypes.description: Object types affected by this action type

exists.description: Whether the link type exists in the ontology

affectedLinkTypes.description: Link types affected by this action type

successRate.description: Success rate as a decimal (0 to 1, rounded to 2 decimal places)

lastExecutedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent execution (null if never executed)

warnings.description: Warnings about missing object types, link types, or other issues

propertyValues.description: Property values set by this edit

linkEdits.description: Link modifications made by this edit

actionTypeApiName.description: API name of the action that produced this edit

actionTypeDisplayName.description: Display name of the action that produced this edit

executionId.description: Execution ID of the action that produced this edit

actionParameters.description: Parameters passed to the action that produced this edit

executedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the edit was made

indexed.description: Whether this edit has been indexed in the search engine

indexedAt.description: Timestamp when this edit was indexed (null if not indexed)

data.description: Array of edit history entries (ordered by most recent first)

nextPageToken.description: Base64-encoded cursor for the next page (null if no more pages)

totalCount.description: Total number of matching edit history entries

errorInstanceId.description: Unique identifier for this specific error occurrence
